title: The pop3 daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^pop3[[:blank:]]" /etc/inetd.conf

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/inetd.conf", comment out the "pop3" entry by running command: 
# chsubserver -r inetd -C /etc/inetd.conf -d -v 'pop3' -p 'tcp'

Restart inetd:
# refresh -s inetd
VulnDiscussion: The pop3 service provides a pop3 server. It supports the pop3 remote mail access protocol. It works with sendmail and bellmail. This service should be disabled if it is not required to prevent attacks.
